description: This file defines cryptographic callback functions for encryption, decryption, hashing, HMAC, signing, and random data generation, specific to client-side encryption in a MongoDB context.

methods.name: makeAES256Hook
methods.description: Creates a callback function for AES-256 encryption or decryption using specified method and mode.

methods.name: randomHook
methods.description: Fills a buffer with cryptographically secure random bytes.

methods.name: sha256Hook
methods.description: Computes SHA-256 hash of input buffer.

methods.name: makeHmacHook
methods.description: Creates a callback function for HMAC calculation with specified algorithm.

methods.name: signRsaSha256Hook
methods.description: Signs data using RSA SHA-256 with a private key.
